caption: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different types of fine-tunning
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during fine-tuning of the Whisper model, specifically for the "full" type of fine-tuning, across different epochs. The x-axis represents the epoch, is labeled as "epoch", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 6, and has tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis represents the WER, is labeled as "WER", has a linear scale, ranges from 20 to 28, and has tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot contains two lines: the grey dotted line with triangle markers represents "tiny full" and starts at approximately 29 WER at epoch 0, decreasing to around 23 at epoch 6, with a notable drop between epochs 2 and 3 from about 27 to 24; the blue dotted line with triangle markers represents "base full" and begins at approximately 22 WER at epoch 0, decreasing to around 19 at epoch 6, with a slight increase between epochs 1 and 2 from about 21 to 21.5 before continuing its overall downward trend.
